testimonials.title: What Passengers Say
testimonials.subtitle: Real reviews from real travelers who chose Busly for their journeys.
testimonials.text1: Incredibly easy booking process. I booked my Cairo to Alexandria ticket in under a minute. The bus was clean, on time, and the Wi-Fi worked perfectly!
testimonials.text2: As a student, I travel back home every weekend. Busly made it so affordable and convenient. The seat selection feature is amazing — I always get my preferred window seat.
testimonials.text3: I use Busly for all my business trips between Cairo and Hurghada. Reliable schedules, comfortable VIP seats, and great customer service when I needed to reschedule.
testimonials.text4: Visited Egypt for the first time and used Busly for the Alexandria to Marsa Matrouh trip. Beautiful coastal route and the bus was extremely comfortable. Highly recommend!
